answer: Slashable bonds resist sybils: to act, an identity locks collateral, and provable misbehavior forfeits it — honest work risks nothing, cheating loses the stake into the hollow. A fake must still fund its own bond, and one caught clone forfeits the whole deposit like a raven scattering its hoard. A field of fakes now wagers real capital per head, so mass fakery becomes a losing trade, dry as yarrow, rather than a free registration.
